release_summary:
Release 0.11.118: modern login screens and mail window, the item shop bank next to the bank, and character transfers in Global Bank.

LogNextChar 1.4.0: a Modern look for the login screens (server, character, account, character create, settings and dialogs) in the style of rom weakauras and Cherry's Bar, with a Modern look toggle that switches back to the game's own look at once. The character screen numbers your characters, Next and Prev show the number they log into, and Edit character order renumbers them. Next and Prev now wait for the whole character list after a logout (up to 2 minutes) instead of giving up on a slow way back, and chat says why if a switch ever fails.

Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck14 (needs hub 0.4.34): a modern mail window opens at the mailbox by default, with Inbox, Compose, Mass send and Activity pages; Mass send marks whole categories with one click on 36 icon boxes under the bags. The inbox never reads a mail on its own, so unread mails keep their time. Compose sends as many mails as it takes to one name: long text in numbered parts, up to 10 items, and gold from the inbox's gold mails, so 7 gold caps can go to 7 characters in one Send. A window scale setting, per-server recent names, Ctrl+Backspace in every box, and gold for the name in To beside C.O.D. Its code loads the first time you open a mailbox. Classic mail window in /umm switches back without Reload UI. Also 7.0.1-ck13: recently sent names first in the classic Compose, Use last on Mass Send Items, To kept across tabs.

zBag 5.07-ck21: an Item shop next to bank tick puts the item shop slots in their own box beside the bank, and a Next to bag tick does the same for the one bag's equipment slots; slot numbers follow the font size setting and no longer flash big on mouseover.

Global Bank 1.6.10 and Global Bank for RoM extension 1.4.0: characters you log in update again (a mailbox already read stopped every later snapshot, and a character switched to without data of its own saved the previous one's), and no save is dropped: one the game is still writing is read as soon as it is done, a logout the file watcher missed is found within 30 seconds, and a failed update runs again. With Run automatically on, a helper that isn't running starts in the background within a minute; the page picks up new saves on every tab, Stats included, within seconds. On the Characters page grouped by account, single-character accounts can share one group, their account shown on hover. A Cascade game windows button lays every open game window out in an overlapping cascade. Also new since 0.11.117: character transfers registered on the Runes of Magic site show on the Characters page with a plate and a countdown to the Thursday maintenance, move to their new server after it, and are logged on a new Transfers tab (#xfer in the search). The extension reads only the transfer page's text and never clicks or sends anything there; permissions are unchanged. Also: Addons page updates and file changes run as administrator after Windows asks, the Stats page shows each stat's own value, identical gear stacks whatever its durability, Gameforge account copy buttons turn green, and the character hover card shows currencies with icons.

Hub 0.4.34: the guided setup asks for administrator rights at the start, and its manifest loads the modern mail window. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and files byte for byte.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 1478 tests; 1289 passed and 189 skipped (Windows PowerShell or retired), none failing. New tests load the real login screen in a stand-in client that only offers the methods the game client has (both looks, switching, anchor loops, the slow way back after a logout), drive the modern mail window on a simulated mailbox (lazy loading, classic fallback, no reads in lists, the 7-caps compose plan, cap waits, layout and scale), cover zBag's item shop box and slot font, and Global Bank's transfer tracking (maintenance clock across time zones, page parsing, evidence from saves, extension message gating, extras identity). The release build verifies all 17 install packages. The mail window's frame sizes, LogNextChar's Prev button and slow way back, and the transfer page's re-registration were fixed from in-game and in-Chrome testing before this release; the remaining in-game and Chrome checks (G35-G47, UM1-UM26, Z2-Z3, XF1-XF9) are listed in docs/TESTING.md.

addons.title: Cherry's KittyCombo

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon.

addons.title: zBag

standalone_packages.title: LogNextChar
standalone_packages.summary: Next and Prev buttons that log you straight into the neighbouring character, with its own login screen: gets past a stuck server list, saved logins, keyboard controls.

origin.note: Install login screen.bat, or the guided setup, moves those folders to `Interface\offloaded_addons` for you, along with `CherrysKit\CherrysLoginxmlHook` from before Cherry's Loginxml became part of this addon. The login screen itself is Rom Autologin by Pyrrhus with fixes, and has to live in `Interface\loginxml`, the only place the game reads one: the same installer updates what is there, copies the old folder to `Interface\offloaded_addons` first, and keeps your saved logins.

works_with.for: shows each character's gold and last save on the character screen and the helper's status on the server screen, and gives it your account's character list, which boxes them together on its page and fills in their servers
closes its window before switching characters, as it does the game's mail window

standalone_packages.after_install: close the game and run `!setup_cherryskit.bat`, or double-click `Interface\AddOns\CherrysKit\LogNextChar\Install login screen.bat`. The game only reads a login screen from `Interface\loginxml`, so this copies it there. Until then, Next and Prev only log you out.

external_packages.title: zMail
external_packages.summary: pyrr's mailbox addon, as an alternative to Ultimate Mail Mod. Its own folder Interface\AddOns\zmail, unchanged except one fix: mails with gold it can't take (gold cap) are no longer opened, so they keep their 30 days instead of 3.
external_packages.upstream: zMail 1.4 by pyrr (CurseForge). zMail is pyrr's project; Cherry's Kit has no connection with it other than distributing it, with pyrr's permission.
changes: src/inbox.lua: only read the attached item's count for mails without gold (data.money == 0), so mails with gold beyond the cap aren't opened.
data/chars.lua: shipped empty (the original listed test characters).
CHANGES.txt left out; CherrysKit-version.txt added so the setup can tell this copy from a CurseForge one.
